behavior: After the existing initial operator selection, authorized effect admission records each waiting assignment once, in arrival order. On release, the first still-open waiter can acquire the lane on its next authorized call. The existing operator may select a different exact assignment when idle.
boundary: An unresolved owner still prevents release, and an absent or conflicting waiter record fails closed. Queuing does not create a tool journal row or execute the call. The exact task and previously journaled call checks precede queue changes.
scopeLimit: Advancement is driven by authorized requests. It does not start a browser, worker or recurring automation. The installed ChatGPT Web workflow still requires release and live qualification.
